output.title: Byeon Woo Seok shares behind-the-scenes snaps from Manila fan meet
output.description: Byeon Woo Seok surely enjoyed his time with his Filipino fans!

text.preview:
Byeon Woo Seok enjoyed his time with his Filipino fans!

On Instagram, the "Lovely Runner" star shared some behind-the-scenes photos from the Manila leg of his "Summer Letter" fan tour at the New Frontier Theater on Saturday.

Among the photos he shared was a snap of him holding a hand banner and another of him signing the polaroid perk for his lucky fans.

In the caption, Woo Seok simply wrote a smile emoji.

In the comments section, fans, including GMA Integrated News showbiz reporter Aubrey Carampel, showered some love to the Korean star.

"Thank you so much for visiting the Philippines. Please come back soon!" Carampel wrote.

"I love you and thank you," another fan said.

Byeon Woo Seok arrived in the country on Friday for his first ever fan meet. Before his sold-out show on Saturday, he met with members of the press at the Shangri-La The Fort in Manila.

The actor recently starred in the Korean drama "Lovely Runner" as the top Hallyu star Ryu Sun Jae.

Previously, he starred in "Record of Youth" alongside Park Bo Gum and also in the film "20th Century Girl."

output.title: Byeon Woo Seok to hold fan meet in Manila this July
output.description: South Korean actor Byeon Woo Seok is returning to Manila this July!

text.preview:
South Korean actor Byeon Woo Seok is returning to Manila this July!

On X (formerly Twitter) Friday, Dunkin' Philippines announced that the "Lovely Runner" star's "Daydreamin" fan meeting will take place on July 19, 7 p.m., at the Araneta Coliseum in Quezon City.

Ticketing details have yet to be announced, so stay tuned!

Byeon Woo Seok was also in Manila in June 2024 for his "Summer Letter" fan meet.

He played the role of top Hallyu star Ryu Sun Jae in "Lovely Runner" alongside South Korean actress Kim Hye Yoon, who played the character of Sol, a big fan of Sun Jae.

He has also starred in "Record of Youth" alongside Park Bo Gum, "Strong Girl Namsoon," and in the movie "20th Century Girl," among others.

output.description: “Lovely Runner” star Byeon Woo-seok pulled a lovely surprise when he met the Filipino media ahead of his first fan meet in the Philippines happening today.

text.preview: MANILA, Philippines — “Lovely Runner” star Byeon Woo-seok pulled a lovely surprise when he met the Filipino media ahead of his first fan meet in the Philippines happening today. The 32-year-old South Korean actor handed out flowers to each and every press member — something that has never been done in any presscon, whether local and foreign — showing how he was quite the charmer off screen, as well. Byeon is in town for the “2024 Byeon Woo-seok Asia Fanmeeting Tour: Summer Letter in Manila” at the New Frontier Theater. According to Happee Sy Go, the lady boss of Pulp Live World, the event presented by Varo Entertainment, TONZ Entertainment, and PULP Live World, quickly sold out. “It’s so nice to be here in the Philippines finally and when I arrived here yesterday, there were so many fans who welcomed us (at the airport). I was so thrilled and excited and I’m actually looking forward to all of this,” said the towering actor, who first made a name for himself as a model. “Yes, it’s my first time here and natutuwa ako sa lahat ng nakikita ko,” he further said, with the help of an interpreter. “Before I read the ‘Lovely Runner’ script, I had actually wanted to do a different kind of role, but when I read the ‘Lovely Runner’ script, I fell in love with the character. I could totally relate. I actually do love romantic comedies,” he shared. He cited his top scenes from the series, namely, his dramatic father-son scene, and his emotional love confessions to his love interest Im Sol, played by Kim Hye-yoon. On how he built such amazing chemistry with his leading ladies like Kim Hye-yoon, he said, “There’s no really like a secret to how I was able to have a good relationship with my co-actors and actresses. articles.title: Byeon Woo Seok shares behind-the-scenes snaps from Manila fan meet
articles.description: Byeon Woo Seok surely enjoyed his time with his Filipino fans!

text.preview:
Byeon Woo Seok enjoyed his time with his Filipino fans!

On Instagram, the "Lovely Runner" star shared some behind-the-scenes photos from the Manila leg of his "Summer Letter" fan tour at the New Frontier Theater on Saturday.

Among the photos he shared was a snap of him holding a hand banner and another of him signing the polaroid perk for his lucky fans.

In the caption, Woo Seok simply wrote a smile emoji.

In the comments section, fans, including GMA Integrated News showbiz reporter Aubrey Carampel, showered some love to the Korean star.

"Thank you so much for visiting the Philippines. Please come back soon!" Carampel wrote.

"I love you and thank you," another fan said.

Byeon Woo Seok arrived in the country on Friday for his first ever fan meet. Before his sold-out show on Saturday, he met with members of the press at the Shangri-La The Fort in Manila.

The actor recently starred in the Korean drama "Lovely Runner" as the top Hallyu star Ryu Sun Jae.

Previously, he starred in "Record of Youth" alongside Park Bo Gum and also in the film "20th Century Girl."

articles.title: Byeon Woo Seok to hold fan meet in Manila this July
articles.description: South Korean actor Byeon Woo Seok is returning to Manila this July!

text.preview:
South Korean actor Byeon Woo Seok is returning to Manila this July!

On X (formerly Twitter) Friday, Dunkin' Philippines announced that the "Lovely Runner" star's "Daydreamin" fan meeting will take place on July 19, 7 p.m., at the Araneta Coliseum in Quezon City.

Ticketing details have yet to be announced, so stay tuned!

Byeon Woo Seok was also in Manila in June 2024 for his "Summer Letter" fan meet.

He played the role of top Hallyu star Ryu Sun Jae in "Lovely Runner" alongside South Korean actress Kim Hye Yoon, who played the character of Sol, a big fan of Sun Jae.

He has also starred in "Record of Youth" alongside Park Bo Gum, "Strong Girl Namsoon," and in the movie "20th Century Girl," among others.

articles.title: ‘Lovely Runner’ star Byeon Woo-seok on newfound fame: It’s like a dream
articles.description: “Lovely Runner” star Byeon Woo-seok pulled a lovely surprise when he met the Filipino media ahead of his first fan meet in the Philippines happening today.

text.preview: MANILA, Philippines — “Lovely Runner” star Byeon Woo-seok pulled a lovely surprise when he met the Filipino media ahead of his first fan meet in the Philippines happening today. The 32-year-old South Korean actor handed out flowers to each and every press member — something that has never been done in any presscon, whether local and foreign — showing how he was quite the charmer off screen, as well. Byeon is in town for the “2024 Byeon Woo-seok Asia Fanmeeting Tour: Summer Letter in Manila” at the New Frontier Theater. According to Happee Sy Go, the lady boss of Pulp Live World, the event presented by Varo Entertainment, TONZ Entertainment, and PULP Live World, quickly sold out. “It’s so nice to be here in the Philippines finally and when I arrived here yesterday, there were so many fans who welcomed us (at the airport). I was so thrilled and excited and I’m actually looking forward to all of this,” said the towering actor, who first made a name for himself as a model. “Yes, it’s my first time here and natutuwa ako sa lahat ng nakikita ko,” he further said, with the help of an interpreter. “Before I read the ‘Lovely Runner’ script, I had actually wanted to do a different kind of role, but when I read the ‘Lovely Runner’ script, I fell in love with the character. I could totally relate. I actually do love romantic comedies,” he shared. He cited his top scenes from the series, namely, his dramatic father-son scene, and his emotional love confessions to his love interest Im Sol, played by Kim Hye-yoon. On how he built such amazing chemistry with his leading ladies like Kim Hye-yoon, he said, “There’s no really like a secret to how I was able to have a good relationship with my co-actors and actresses. articles.title: Byeon Woo Seok shares behind-the-scenes snaps from Manila fan meet
articles.description: Byeon Woo Seok surely enjoyed his time with his Filipino fans!

text.preview:
Byeon Woo Seok enjoyed his time with his Filipino fans!

On Instagram, the "Lovely Runner" star shared some behind-the-scenes photos from the Manila leg of his "Summer Letter" fan tour at the New Frontier Theater on Saturday.

Among the photos he shared was a snap of him holding a hand banner and another of him signing the polaroid perk for his lucky fans.

In the caption, Woo Seok simply wrote a smile emoji.

In the comments section, fans, including GMA Integrated News showbiz reporter Aubrey Carampel, showered some love to the Korean star.

"Thank you so much for visiting the Philippines. Please come back soon!" Carampel wrote.

"I love you and thank you," another fan said.

Byeon Woo Seok arrived in the country on Friday for his first ever fan meet. Before his sold-out show on Saturday, he met with members of the press at the Shangri-La The Fort in Manila.

The actor recently starred in the Korean drama "Lovely Runner" as the top Hallyu star Ryu Sun Jae.

Previously, he starred in "Record of Youth" alongside Park Bo Gum and also in the film "20th Century Girl."

articles.title: Byeon Woo Seok to hold fan meet in Manila this July
articles.description: South Korean actor Byeon Woo Seok is returning to Manila this July!

text.preview:
South Korean actor Byeon Woo Seok is returning to Manila this July!

On X (formerly Twitter) Friday, Dunkin' Philippines announced that the "Lovely Runner" star's "Daydreamin" fan meeting will take place on July 19, 7 p.m., at the Araneta Coliseum in Quezon City.

Ticketing details have yet to be announced, so stay tuned!

Byeon Woo Seok was also in Manila in June 2024 for his "Summer Letter" fan meet.

He played the role of top Hallyu star Ryu Sun Jae in "Lovely Runner" alongside South Korean actress Kim Hye Yoon, who played the character of Sol, a big fan of Sun Jae.

He has also starred in "Record of Youth" alongside Park Bo Gum, "Strong Girl Namsoon," and in the movie "20th Century Girl," among others.

articles.title: ‘Lovely Runner’ star Byeon Woo-seok on newfound fame: It’s like a dream
articles.description: “Lovely Runner” star Byeon Woo-seok pulled a lovely surprise when he met the Filipino media ahead of his first fan meet in the Philippines happening today.

text.preview: MANILA, Philippines — “Lovely Runner” star Byeon Woo-seok pulled a lovely surprise when he met the Filipino media ahead of his first fan meet in the Philippines happening today. The 32-year-old South Korean actor handed out flowers to each and every press member — something that has never been done in any presscon, whether local and foreign — showing how he was quite the charmer off screen, as well. Byeon is in town for the “2024 Byeon Woo-seok Asia Fanmeeting Tour: Summer Letter in Manila” at the New Frontier Theater. According to Happee Sy Go, the lady boss of Pulp Live World, the event presented by Varo Entertainment, TONZ Entertainment, and PULP Live World, quickly sold out. “It’s so nice to be here in the Philippines finally and when I arrived here yesterday, there were so many fans who welcomed us (at the airport). I was so thrilled and excited and I’m actually looking forward to all of this,” said the towering actor, who first made a name for himself as a model. “Yes, it’s my first time here and natutuwa ako sa lahat ng nakikita ko,” he further said, with the help of an interpreter. “Before I read the ‘Lovely Runner’ script, I had actually wanted to do a different kind of role, but when I read the ‘Lovely Runner’ script, I fell in love with the character. I could totally relate. I actually do love romantic comedies,” he shared. He cited his top scenes from the series, namely, his dramatic father-son scene, and his emotional love confessions to his love interest Im Sol, played by Kim Hye-yoon. On how he built such amazing chemistry with his leading ladies like Kim Hye-yoon, he said, “There’s no really like a secret to how I was able to have a good relationship with my co-actors and actresses. articles.title: Byeon Woo Seok shares behind-the-scenes snaps from Manila fan meet
articles.description: Byeon Woo Seok surely enjoyed his time with his Filipino fans!

text.preview:
Byeon Woo Seok enjoyed his time with his Filipino fans!

On Instagram, the "Lovely Runner" star shared some behind-the-scenes photos from the Manila leg of his "Summer Letter" fan tour at the New Frontier Theater on Saturday.

Among the photos he shared was a snap of him holding a hand banner and another of him signing the polaroid perk for his lucky fans.

In the caption, Woo Seok simply wrote a smile emoji.

In the comments section, fans, including GMA Integrated News showbiz reporter Aubrey Carampel, showered some love to the Korean star.

"Thank you so much for visiting the Philippines. Please come back soon!" Carampel wrote.

"I love you and thank you," another fan said.

Byeon Woo Seok arrived in the country on Friday for his first ever fan meet. Before his sold-out show on Saturday, he met with members of the press at the Shangri-La The Fort in Manila.

The actor recently starred in the Korean drama "Lovely Runner" as the top Hallyu star Ryu Sun Jae.

Previously, he starred in "Record of Youth" alongside Park Bo Gum and also in the film "20th Century Girl."

articles.title: Byeon Woo Seok to hold fan meet in Manila this July
articles.description: South Korean actor Byeon Woo Seok is returning to Manila this July!

text.preview:
South Korean actor Byeon Woo Seok is returning to Manila this July!

On X (formerly Twitter) Friday, Dunkin' Philippines announced that the "Lovely Runner" star's "Daydreamin" fan meeting will take place on July 19, 7 p.m., at the Araneta Coliseum in Quezon City.

Ticketing details have yet to be announced, so stay tuned!

Byeon Woo Seok was also in Manila in June 2024 for his "Summer Letter" fan meet.

He played the role of top Hallyu star Ryu Sun Jae in "Lovely Runner" alongside South Korean actress Kim Hye Yoon, who played the character of Sol, a big fan of Sun Jae.

He has also starred in "Record of Youth" alongside Park Bo Gum, "Strong Girl Namsoon," and in the movie "20th Century Girl," among others.

articles.title: ‘Lovely Runner’ star Byeon Woo-seok on newfound fame: It’s like a dream
articles.description: “Lovely Runner” star Byeon Woo-seok pulled a lovely surprise when he met the Filipino media ahead of his first fan meet in the Philippines happening today.

text.preview: MANILA, Philippines — “Lovely Runner” star Byeon Woo-seok pulled a lovely surprise when he met the Filipino media ahead of his first fan meet in the Philippines happening today. The 32-year-old South Korean actor handed out flowers to each and every press member — something that has never been done in any presscon, whether local and foreign — showing how he was quite the charmer off screen, as well. Byeon is in town for the “2024 Byeon Woo-seok Asia Fanmeeting Tour: Summer Letter in Manila” at the New Frontier Theater. According to Happee Sy Go, the lady boss of Pulp Live World, the event presented by Varo Entertainment, TONZ Entertainment, and PULP Live World, quickly sold out. “It’s so nice to be here in the Philippines finally and when I arrived here yesterday, there were so many fans who welcomed us (at the airport). I was so thrilled and excited and I’m actually looking forward to all of this,” said the towering actor, who first made a name for himself as a model. “Yes, it’s my first time here and natutuwa ako sa lahat ng nakikita ko,” he further said, with the help of an interpreter. “Before I read the ‘Lovely Runner’ script, I had actually wanted to do a different kind of role, but when I read the ‘Lovely Runner’ script, I fell in love with the character. I could totally relate. I actually do love romantic comedies,” he shared. He cited his top scenes from the series, namely, his dramatic father-son scene, and his emotional love confessions to his love interest Im Sol, played by Kim Hye-yoon. On how he built such amazing chemistry with his leading ladies like Kim Hye-yoon, he said, “There’s no really like a secret to how I was able to have a good relationship with my co-actors and actresses. articles.title: Byeon Woo Seok shares behind-the-scenes snaps from Manila fan meet
articles.description: Byeon Woo Seok surely enjoyed his time with his Filipino fans!

text.preview:
Byeon Woo Seok enjoyed his time with his Filipino fans!

On Instagram, the "Lovely Runner" star shared some behind-the-scenes photos from the Manila leg of his "Summer Letter" fan tour at the New Frontier Theater on Saturday.

Among the photos he shared was a snap of him holding a hand banner and another of him signing the polaroid perk for his lucky fans.

In the caption, Woo Seok simply wrote a smile emoji.

In the comments section, fans, including GMA Integrated News showbiz reporter Aubrey Carampel, showered some love to the Korean star.

"Thank you so much for visiting the Philippines. Please come back soon!" Carampel wrote.

"I love you and thank you," another fan said.

Byeon Woo Seok arrived in the country on Friday for his first ever fan meet. Before his sold-out show on Saturday, he met with members of the press at the Shangri-La The Fort in Manila.

The actor recently starred in the Korean drama "Lovely Runner" as the top Hallyu star Ryu Sun Jae.

Previously, he starred in "Record of Youth" alongside Park Bo Gum and also in the film "20th Century Girl."

articles.title: Byeon Woo Seok to hold fan meet in Manila this July
articles.description: South Korean actor Byeon Woo Seok is returning to Manila this July!

text.preview:
South Korean actor Byeon Woo Seok is returning to Manila this July!

On X (formerly Twitter) Friday, Dunkin' Philippines announced that the "Lovely Runner" star's "Daydreamin" fan meeting will take place on July 19, 7 p.m., at the Araneta Coliseum in Quezon City.

Ticketing details have yet to be announced, so stay tuned!

Byeon Woo Seok was also in Manila in June 2024 for his "Summer Letter" fan meet.

He played the role of top Hallyu star Ryu Sun Jae in "Lovely Runner" alongside South Korean actress Kim Hye Yoon, who played the character of Sol, a big fan of Sun Jae.

He has also starred in "Record of Youth" alongside Park Bo Gum, "Strong Girl Namsoon," and in the movie "20th Century Girl," among others.

text.preview: MANILA, Philippines — “Lovely Runner” star Byeon Woo-seok pulled a lovely surprise when he met the Filipino media ahead of his first fan meet in the Philippines happening today. The 32-year-old South Korean actor handed out flowers to each and every press member — something that has never been done in any presscon, whether local and foreign — showing how he was quite the charmer off screen, as well. Byeon is in town for the “2024 Byeon Woo-seok Asia Fanmeeting Tour: Summer Letter in Manila” at the New Frontier Theater. According to Happee Sy Go, the lady boss of Pulp Live World, the event presented by Varo Entertainment, TONZ Entertainment, and PULP Live World, quickly sold out. “It’s so nice to be here in the Philippines finally and when I arrived here yesterday, there were so many fans who welcomed us (at the airport). I was so thrilled and excited and I’m actually looking forward to all of this,” said the towering actor, who first made a name for himself as a model. “Yes, it’s my first time here and natutuwa ako sa lahat ng nakikita ko,” he further said, with the help of an interpreter. “Before I read the ‘Lovely Runner’ script, I had actually wanted to do a different kind of role, but when I read the ‘Lovely Runner’ script, I fell in love with the character. I could totally relate. I actually do love romantic comedies,” he shared. He cited his top scenes from the series, namely, his dramatic father-son scene, and his emotional love confessions to his love interest Im Sol, played by Kim Hye-yoon. articles.title: Byeon Woo Seok shares behind-the-scenes snaps from Manila fan meet
articles.description: Byeon Woo Seok surely enjoyed his time with his Filipino fans!

text.preview:
Byeon Woo Seok enjoyed his time with his Filipino fans!

On Instagram, the "Lovely Runner" star shared some behind-the-scenes photos from the Manila leg of his "Summer Letter" fan tour at the New Frontier Theater on Saturday.

Among the photos he shared was a snap of him holding a hand banner and another of him signing the polaroid perk for his lucky fans.

In the caption, Woo Seok simply wrote a smile emoji.

In the comments section, fans, including GMA Integrated News showbiz reporter Aubrey Carampel, showered some love to the Korean star.

"Thank you so much for visiting the Philippines. Please come back soon!" Carampel wrote.

"I love you and thank you," another fan said.

Byeon Woo Seok arrived in the country on Friday for his first ever fan meet. Before his sold-out show on Saturday, he met with members of the press at the Shangri-La The Fort in Manila.

The actor recently starred in the Korean drama "Lovely Runner" as the top Hallyu star Ryu Sun Jae.

Previously, he starred in "Record of Youth" alongside Park Bo Gum and also in the film "20th Century Girl."

articles.title: Byeon Woo Seok to hold fan meet in Manila this July
articles.description: South Korean actor Byeon Woo Seok is returning to Manila this July!

text.preview:
South Korean actor Byeon Woo Seok is returning to Manila this July!

On X (formerly Twitter) Friday, Dunkin' Philippines announced that the "Lovely Runner" star's "Daydreamin" fan meeting will take place on July 19, 7 p.m., at the Araneta Coliseum in Quezon City.

Ticketing details have yet to be announced, so stay tuned!

Byeon Woo Seok was also in Manila in June 2024 for his "Summer Letter" fan meet.

He played the role of top Hallyu star Ryu Sun Jae in "Lovely Runner" alongside South Korean actress Kim Hye Yoon, who played the character of Sol, a big fan of Sun Jae.

He has also starred in "Record of Youth" alongside Park Bo Gum, "Strong Girl Namsoon," and in the movie "20th Century Girl," among others.

articles.title: Byeon Woo Seok shares behind-the-scenes snaps from Manila fan meet
articles.description: Byeon Woo Seok surely enjoyed his time with his Filipino fans!

text.preview:
Byeon Woo Seok enjoyed his time with his Filipino fans!

On Instagram, the "Lovely Runner" star shared some behind-the-scenes photos from the Manila leg of his "Summer Letter" fan tour at the New Frontier Theater on Saturday.

Among the photos he shared was a snap of him holding a hand banner and another of him signing the polaroid perk for his lucky fans.

In the caption, Woo Seok simply wrote a smile emoji.

In the comments section, fans, including GMA Integrated News showbiz reporter Aubrey Carampel, showered some love to the Korean star.

"Thank you so much for visiting the Philippines. Please come back soon!" Carampel wrote.

"I love you and thank you," another fan said.

Byeon Woo Seok arrived in the country on Friday for his first ever fan meet. Before his sold-out show on Saturday, he met with members of the press at the Shangri-La The Fort in Manila.

The actor recently starred in the Korean drama "Lovely Runner" as the top Hallyu star Ryu Sun Jae.

Previously, he starred in "Record of Youth" alongside Park Bo Gum and also in the film "20th Century Girl."

articles.title: Byeon Woo Seok to hold fan meet in Manila this July
articles.description: South Korean actor Byeon Woo Seok is returning to Manila this July!

text.preview:
South Korean actor Byeon Woo Seok is returning to Manila this July!

On X (formerly Twitter) Friday, Dunkin' Philippines announced that the "Lovely Runner" star's "Daydreamin" fan meeting will take place on July 19, 7 p.m., at the Araneta Coliseum in Quezon City.

Ticketing details have yet to be announced, so stay tuned!

Byeon Woo Seok was also in Manila in June 2024 for his "Summer Letter" fan meet.

He played the role of top Hallyu star Ryu Sun Jae in "Lovely Runner" alongside South Korean actress Kim Hye Yoon, who played the character of Sol, a big fan of Sun Jae.

He has also starred in "Record of Youth" alongside Park Bo Gum, "Strong Girl Namsoon," and in the movie "20th Century Girl," among others.

articles.title: ‘Lovely Runner’ star Byeon Woo-seok on newfound fame: It’s like a dream
articles.description: “Lovely Runner” star Byeon Woo-seok pulled a lovely surprise when he met the Filipino media ahead of his first fan meet in the Philippines happening today.

text.preview: MANILA, Philippines — “Lovely Runner” star Byeon Woo-seok pulled a lovely surprise when he met the Filipino media ahead of his first fan meet in the Philippines happening today. The 32-year-old South Korean actor handed out flowers to each and every press member — something that has never been done in any presscon, whether local and foreign — showing how he was quite the charmer off screen, as well. Byeon is in town for the “2024 Byeon Woo-seok Asia Fanmeeting Tour: Summer Letter in Manila” at the New Frontier Theater. According to Happee Sy Go, the lady boss of Pulp Live World, the event presented by Varo Entertainment, TONZ Entertainment, and PULP Live World, quickly sold out. “It’s so nice to be here in the Philippines finally and when I arrived here yesterday, there were so many fans who welcomed us (at the airport). I was so thrilled and excited and I’m actually looking forward to all of this,” said the towering actor, who first made a name for himself as a model. “Yes, it’s my first time here and natutuwa ako sa lahat ng nakikita ko,” he further said, with the help of an interpreter. “Before I read the ‘Lovely Runner’ script, I had actually wanted to do a different kind of role, but when I read the ‘Lovely Runner’ script, I fell in love with the character. I could totally relate. I actually do love romantic comedies,” he shared. He cited his top scenes from the series, namely, his dramatic father-son scene, and his emotional love confessions to his love interest Im Sol, played by Kim Hye-yoon. On how he built such amazing chemistry with his leading ladies like Kim Hye-yoon, he said, “There’s no really like a secret to how I was able to have a good relationship with my co-actors and actresses. articles.title: Byeon Woo Seok shares behind-the-scenes snaps from Manila fan meet
articles.description: Byeon Woo Seok surely enjoyed his time with his Filipino fans!

text.preview:
Byeon Woo Seok enjoyed his time with his Filipino fans!

On Instagram, the "Lovely Runner" star shared some behind-the-scenes photos from the Manila leg of his "Summer Letter" fan tour at the New Frontier Theater on Saturday.

Among the photos he shared was a snap of him holding a hand banner and another of him signing the polaroid perk for his lucky fans.

In the caption, Woo Seok simply wrote a smile emoji.

In the comments section, fans, including GMA Integrated News showbiz reporter Aubrey Carampel, showered some love to the Korean star.

"Thank you so much for visiting the Philippines. Please come back soon!" Carampel wrote.

"I love you and thank you," another fan said.

Byeon Woo Seok arrived in the country on Friday for his first ever fan meet. Before his sold-out show on Saturday, he met with members of the press at the Shangri-La The Fort in Manila.

The actor recently starred in the Korean drama "Lovely Runner" as the top Hallyu star Ryu Sun Jae.

Previously, he starred in "Record of Youth" alongside Park Bo Gum and also in the film "20th Century Girl."

output.title: Of heartfelt moments and human barricades: Byeon Woo-seok Manila fan meeting
output.description: During shows, certain members of the Pulp team are given walkie-talkies so they can communicate properly with the rest of the staff.

text.preview: During shows, certain members of the Pulp team are given walkie-talkies so they can communicate properly with the rest of the staff. The first time I was given one, I was petrified by the prospect of it switching on and hearing a voice issuing a command through lots of crackling and static. My worst nightmare came true after the 2024 Byeon Woo-seok Asia Fan Meeting Tour: Summer Letter in Manila at the New Frontier Theater last June 22. After the show ended and the last few fans had trickled out the exits, my teammates and I packed up our things and made our way back inside the theater. We planned to pass through the event bowl on our way to the backstage area, but we were stopped by a member of the crew, who asked us to let them finish dismantling some equipment onstage first. So, we sat down in what had been the VIP section to wait. Suddenly, the walkie-talkie clipped to one of my teammates’ belts crackled to life, and we heard a woman’s voice saying urgently, “Lahat ng Pulp staff, labas kayo dito sa backstage area kasi dinudumog yung artist.” We exploded out of our seats. We literally dropped everything we were holding and raced towards the exit that led to the artists’ entrance. The moment I passed through the door, I was buffeted by a wall of sound. I was disoriented for a few seconds because I could hear nothing but screaming. Then it clicked: it was the fans who had waited around at the venue for a glimpse of Byeon Woo-seok. They were yelling at the top of their lungs because they saw him leave the building, wave for a bit, and then disappear into the long black car that would take him back to his hotel. That fact had barely registered in my brain when one of the bouncers ran up to us. He instructed us to form a human barricade to keep the fans from spilling out into the street, allowing Byeon Woo-seok’s car to pass safely. The actor was just in the Philippines last year for his "Daydreamin'" fan meet held at the Araneta Coliseum, and the year before that in the New Frontier Theater for his "Summer Letter" Asia Fanmeeting tour. Woo-seok started out as a model before transitioning into acting for cameos in "Dear My Friends," "Moon Lovers: Scarlet Heart Ryeo," and "Weightlifting Fairy Kim Bok-joo." He gained attention for lead roles in "Record of Youth," "Strong Girl Namsoon," "Moonshine," "Soulmate," and his full film debut, "20th Century Girl." We planned to pass through the event bowl on our way to the backstage area, but we were stopped by a member of the crew, who asked us to let them finish dismantling some equipment onstage first. So, we sat down in what had been the VIP section to wait. Suddenly, the walkie-talkie clipped to one of my teammates’ belts crackled to life, and we heard a woman’s voice saying urgently, “Lahat ng Pulp staff, labas kayo dito sa backstage area kasi dinudumog yung artist.” We exploded out of our seats. We literally dropped everything we were holding and raced towards the exit that led to the artists’ entrance. The moment I passed through the door, I was buffeted by a wall of sound. I was disoriented for a few seconds because I could hear nothing but screaming. Then it clicked: it was the fans who had waited around at the venue for a glimpse of Byeon Woo-seok. They were yelling at the top of their lungs because they saw him leave the building, wave for a bit, and then disappear into the long black car that would take him back to his hotel. That fact had barely registered in my brain when one of the bouncers ran up to us. He instructed us to form a human barricade to keep the fans from spilling out into the street, allowing Byeon Woo-seok’s car to pass safely. text.preview: MANILA, Philippines — Korean actor Byeon Woo-seok is coming back to the Philippines, fresh off the successful run of his latest series "Perfect Crown" opposite IU. "Therefore, the Secret Library invites you here to ensure you may take out and read again the time that has been frozen, and record new memories," the agency said. The final image on the agency's carousel was a fan meeting lineup that includes Manila among the Asian cities that the tour will be held. articles.title: Of heartfelt moments and human barricades: Byeon Woo-seok Manila fan meeting
articles.description: During shows, certain members of the Pulp team are given walkie-talkies so they can communicate properly with the rest of the staff.

text.preview: During shows, certain members of the Pulp team are given walkie-talkies so they can communicate properly with the rest of the staff. The first time I was given one, I was petrified by the prospect of it switching on and hearing a voice issuing a command through lots of crackling and static. My worst nightmare came true after the 2024 Byeon Woo-seok Asia Fan Meeting Tour: Summer Letter in Manila at the New Frontier Theater last June 22. After the show ended and the last few fans had trickled out the exits, my teammates and I packed up our things and made our way back inside the theater. We planned to pass through the event bowl on our way to the backstage area, but we were stopped by a member of the crew, who asked us to let them finish dismantling some equipment onstage first. So, we sat down in what had been the VIP section to wait. Suddenly, the walkie-talkie clipped to one of my teammates’ belts crackled to life, and we heard a woman’s voice saying urgently, “Lahat ng Pulp staff, labas kayo dito sa backstage area kasi dinudumog yung artist.” We exploded out of our seats. We literally dropped everything we were holding and raced towards the exit that led to the artists’ entrance. The moment I passed through the door, I was buffeted by a wall of sound. I was disoriented for a few seconds because I could hear nothing but screaming. Then it clicked: it was the fans who had waited around at the venue for a glimpse of Byeon Woo-seok. They were yelling at the top of their lungs because they saw him leave the building, wave for a bit, and then disappear into the long black car that would take him back to his hotel. That fact had barely registered in my brain when one of the bouncers ran up to us. He instructed us to form a human barricade to keep the fans from spilling out into the street, allowing Byeon Woo-seok’s car to pass safely. articles.title: Of heartfelt moments and human barricades: Byeon Woo-seok Manila fan meeting
articles.description: During shows, certain members of the Pulp team are given walkie-talkies so they can communicate properly with the rest of the staff.

text.preview: During shows, certain members of the Pulp team are given walkie-talkies so they can communicate properly with the rest of the staff. The first time I was given one, I was petrified by the prospect of it switching on and hearing a voice issuing a command through lots of crackling and static. My worst nightmare came true after the 2024 Byeon Woo-seok Asia Fan Meeting Tour: Summer Letter in Manila at the New Frontier Theater last June 22. After the show ended and the last few fans had trickled out the exits, my teammates and I packed up our things and made our way back inside the theater. We planned to pass through the event bowl on our way to the backstage area, but we were stopped by a member of the crew, who asked us to let them finish dismantling some equipment onstage first. So, we sat down in what had been the VIP section to wait. Suddenly, the walkie-talkie clipped to one of my teammates’ belts crackled to life, and we heard a woman’s voice saying urgently, “Lahat ng Pulp staff, labas kayo dito sa backstage area kasi dinudumog yung artist.” We exploded out of our seats. We literally dropped everything we were holding and raced towards the exit that led to the artists’ entrance. The moment I passed through the door, I was buffeted by a wall of sound. I was disoriented for a few seconds because I could hear nothing but screaming. Then it clicked: it was the fans who had waited around at the venue for a glimpse of Byeon Woo-seok. They were yelling at the top of their lungs because they saw him leave the building, wave for a bit, and then disappear into the long black car that would take him back to his hotel. That fact had barely registered in my brain when one of the bouncers ran up to us. He instructed us to form a human barricade to keep the fans from spilling out into the street, allowing Byeon Woo-seok’s car to pass safely. articles.description: During shows, certain members of the Pulp team are given walkie-talkies so they can communicate properly with the rest of the staff.

text.preview: During shows, certain members of the Pulp team are given walkie-talkies so they can communicate properly with the rest of the staff. The first time I was given one, I was petrified by the prospect of it switching on and hearing a voice issuing a command through lots of crackling and static. My worst nightmare came true after the 2024 Byeon Woo-seok Asia Fan Meeting Tour: Summer Letter in Manila at the New Frontier Theater last June 22. After the show ended and the last few fans had trickled out the exits, my teammates and I packed up our things and made our way back inside the theater. We planned to pass through the event bowl on our way to the backstage area, but we were stopped by a member of the crew, who asked us to let them finish dismantling some equipment onstage first. So, we sat down in what had been the VIP section to wait. Suddenly, the walkie-talkie clipped to one of my teammates’ belts crackled to life, and we heard a woman’s voice saying urgently, “Lahat ng Pulp staff, labas kayo dito sa backstage area kasi dinudumog yung artist.” We exploded out of our seats. We literally dropped everything we were holding and raced towards the exit that led to the artists’ entrance. The moment I passed through the door, I was buffeted by a wall of sound. I was disoriented for a few seconds because I could hear nothing but screaming. Then it clicked: it was the fans who had waited around at the venue for a glimpse of Byeon Woo-seok. They were yelling at the top of their lungs because they saw him leave the building, wave for a bit, and then disappear into the long black car that would take him back to his hotel. That fact had barely registered in my brain when one of the bouncers ran up to us. He instructed us to form a human barricade to keep the fans from spilling out into the street, allowing Byeon Woo-seok’s car to pass safely. articles.description: During shows, certain members of the Pulp team are given walkie-talkies so they can communicate properly with the rest of the staff.

text.preview: During shows, certain members of the Pulp team are given walkie-talkies so they can communicate properly with the rest of the staff. The first time I was given one, I was petrified by the prospect of it switching on and hearing a voice issuing a command through lots of crackling and static. After the show ended and the last few fans had trickled out the exits, my teammates and I packed up our things and made our way back inside the theater. We planned to pass through the event bowl on our way to the backstage area, but we were stopped by a member of the crew, who asked us to let them finish dismantling some equipment onstage first. So, we sat down in what had been the VIP section to wait. Suddenly, the walkie-talkie clipped to one of my teammates’ belts crackled to life, and we heard a woman’s voice saying urgently, “Lahat ng Pulp staff, labas kayo dito sa backstage area kasi dinudumog yung artist.” We exploded out of our seats. We literally dropped everything we were holding and raced towards the exit that led to the artists’ entrance. The moment I passed through the door, I was buffeted by a wall of sound. articles.title: Of heartfelt moments and human barricades: Byeon Woo-seok Manila fan meeting
articles.description: During shows, certain members of the Pulp team are given walkie-talkies so they can communicate properly with the rest of the staff.

text.preview: During shows, certain members of the Pulp team are given walkie-talkies so they can communicate properly with the rest of the staff. The first time I was given one, I was petrified by the prospect of it switching on and hearing a voice issuing a command through lots of crackling and static. My worst nightmare came true after the 2024 Byeon Woo-seok Asia Fan Meeting Tour: Summer Letter in Manila at the New Frontier Theater last June 22. After the show ended and the last few fans had trickled out the exits, my teammates and I packed up our things and made our way back inside the theater. We planned to pass through the event bowl on our way to the backstage area, but we were stopped by a member of the crew, who asked us to let them finish dismantling some equipment onstage first. So, we sat down in what had been the VIP section to wait. Suddenly, the walkie-talkie clipped to one of my teammates’ belts crackled to life, and we heard a woman’s voice saying urgently, “Lahat ng Pulp staff, labas kayo dito sa backstage area kasi dinudumog yung artist.” We exploded out of our seats. We literally dropped everything we were holding and raced towards the exit that led to the artists’ entrance. The moment I passed through the door, I was buffeted by a wall of sound. I was disoriented for a few seconds because I could hear nothing but screaming. Then it clicked: it was the fans who had waited around at the venue for a glimpse of Byeon Woo-seok. They were yelling at the top of their lungs because they saw him leave the building, wave for a bit, and then disappear into the long black car that would take him back to his hotel. That fact had barely registered in my brain when one of the bouncers ran up to us. He instructed us to form a human barricade to keep the fans from spilling out into the street, allowing Byeon Woo-seok’s car to pass safely. output.description: Byeon Woo Seok surely enjoyed his time with his Filipino fans!
output.text:
Byeon Woo Seok enjoyed his time with his Filipino fans!

On Instagram, the "Lovely Runner" star shared some behind-the-scenes photos from the Manila leg of his "Summer Letter" fan tour at the New Frontier Theater on Saturday.

Among the photos he shared was a snap of him holding a hand banner and another of him signing the polaroid perk for his lucky fans.

In the caption, Woo Seok simply wrote a smile emoji.

In the comments section, fans, including GMA Integrated News showbiz reporter Aubrey Carampel, showered some love to the Korean star.

"Thank you so much for visiting the Philippines. Please come back soon!" Carampel wrote.

"I love you and thank you," another fan said.

Byeon Woo Seok arrived in the country on Friday for his first ever fan meet. Before his sold-out show on Saturday, he met with members of the press at the Shangri-La The Fort in Manila.

The actor recently starred in the Korean drama "Lovely Runner" as the top Hallyu star Ryu Sun Jae.

Previously, he starred in "Record of Youth" alongside Park Bo Gum and also in the film "20th Century Girl."

Ticketing details have yet to be announced, so stay tuned!

Byeon Woo Seok was also in Manila in June 2024 for his "Summer Letter" fan meet.

He played the role of top Hallyu star Ryu Sun Jae in "Lovely Runner" alongside South Korean actress Kim Hye Yoon, who played the character of Sol, a big fan of Sun Jae.

He has also starred in "Record of Youth" alongside Park Bo Gum, "Strong Girl Namsoon," and in the movie "20th Century Girl," among others.

output.title: ‘Lovely Runner’ star Byeon Woo-seok on newfound fame: It’s like a dream
output.description: “Lovely Runner” star Byeon Woo-seok pulled a lovely surprise when he met the Filipino media ahead of his first fan meet in the Philippines happening today.
output.text: MANILA, Philippines — “Lovely Runner” star Byeon Woo-seok pulled a lovely surprise when he met the Filipino media ahead of his first fan meet in the Philippines happening today. The 32-year-old South Korean actor handed out flowers to each and every press member — something that has never been done in any presscon, whether local and foreign — showing how he was quite the charmer off screen, as well. Byeon is in town for the “2024 Byeon Woo-seok Asia Fanmeeting Tour: Summer Letter in Manila” at the New Frontier Theater. According to Happee Sy Go, the lady boss of Pulp Live World, the event presented by Varo Entertainment, TONZ Entertainment, and PULP Live World, quickly sold out. “It’s so nice to be here in the Philippines finally and when I arrived here yesterday, there were so many fans who welcomed us (at the airport). I was so thrilled and excited and I’m actually looking forward to all of this,” said the towering actor, who first made a name for himself as a model. “Yes, it’s my first time here and natutuwa ako sa lahat ng nakikita ko,” he further said, with the help of an interpreter. “Before I read the ‘Lovely Runner’ script, I had actually wanted to do a different kind of role, but when I read the ‘Lovely Runner’ script, I fell in love with the character. I could totally relate. I actually do love romantic comedies,” he shared. He cited his top scenes from the series, namely, his dramatic father-son scene, and his emotional love confessions to his love interest Im Sol, played by Kim Hye-yoon. On how he built such amazing chemistry with his leading ladies like Kim Hye-yoon, he said, “There’s no really like a secret to how I was able to have a good relationship with my co-actors and actresses. But one thing that made me have a good relationship with my costars is me meeting good actresses, as well because they also love the projects that they are doing. So our love for the new drama or whatever we are doing makes us connect together.” “I don’t really do a personal approach or do something just to make us close. It comes from both our hard work and our love towards what we do,” he added. Byeon appeared still overwhelmed by the “unexpected” overseas reception to his character and to the project. He has been an actor for eight years now but his career just hit crazy heights after “Lovely Runner,” which premiered on tvN last April and also streamed on Viu for the international audiences. As per Social Blade, the show led to his Instagram following skyrocketing to 2.43 million new followers within a month. As of May, it has accumulated 8.3 million followers. Reflecting on his soaring popularity, he stressed he’s still used to it. “Everything itself, my day-to-day (experience) has been a big surprise. Like yesterday, at the airport, I saw a huge crowd. That was amazing and amusing on my end. Also me, just doing this presscon, it’s one of my dreams come true. Until now, I’m still not used to this sudden attention. It’s actually like a dream.” In past interviews, Byeon said that he received multiple acting offers following “Lovely Runner.” However, he told the Pinoy press yesterday that he doesn’t have any role or genre in mind for his next projects. He, nevertheless, hinted that he’s going to do another romantic comedy to be released within the next few months. Meanwhile, the Manila stop is just the latest in a series of jampacked fan meetings all over Asia. “Just the fact that I’m able to go to different places, that in itself is very exciting,” he said of his first Asia tour. “But most importantly, I get to see the culture of these different countries. output.title: Of heartfelt moments and human barricades: Byeon Woo-seok Manila fan meeting
output.description: During shows, certain members of the Pulp team are given walkie-talkies so they can communicate properly with the rest of the staff.
output.text: During shows, certain members of the Pulp team are given walkie-talkies so they can communicate properly with the rest of the staff. The first time I was given one, I was petrified by the prospect of it switching on and hearing a voice issuing a command through lots of crackling and static. My worst nightmare came true after the 2024 Byeon Woo-seok Asia Fan Meeting Tour: Summer Letter in Manila at the New Frontier Theater last June 22. After the show ended and the last few fans had trickled out the exits, my teammates and I packed up our things and made our way back inside the theater. We planned to pass through the event bowl on our way to the backstage area, but we were stopped by a member of the crew, who asked us to let them finish dismantling some equipment onstage first. So, we sat down in what had been the VIP section to wait. Suddenly, the walkie-talkie clipped to one of my teammates’ belts crackled to life, and we heard a woman’s voice saying urgently, “Lahat ng Pulp staff, labas kayo dito sa backstage area kasi dinudumog yung artist.” We exploded out of our seats. We literally dropped everything we were holding and raced towards the exit that led to the artists’ entrance. The moment I passed through the door, I was buffeted by a wall of sound. I was disoriented for a few seconds because I could hear nothing but screaming. Then it clicked: it was the fans who had waited around at the venue for a glimpse of Byeon Woo-seok. They were yelling at the top of their lungs because they saw him leave the building, wave for a bit, and then disappear into the long black car that would take him back to his hotel. That fact had barely registered in my brain when one of the bouncers ran up to us. He instructed us to form a human barricade to keep the fans from spilling out into the street, allowing Byeon Woo-seok’s car to pass safely. We leapt into action, fanning out along the sidewalk and linking arms. My muscles screamed in protest as I dug in my heels, leaning back with all my weight to keep the fans at bay. It felt like a wave of humanity crashing against us, each surge threatening to topple our fragile line. The strain was evident on the faces of the other Pulp staffers, their knuckles white as they gripped each other’s arms, determined not to break. No matter where I looked, I could see my teammates struggling to maintain their balance, trying to keep from being knocked off their feet by the fans who were pushing and pulling in an attempt to get as close to Byeon Woo-seok’s car as possible. The air was thick with the mingled scents of sweat and anticipation, the fans’ pleas and security’s shouts blending into a single, urgent roar. As hard as that moment was for all of us, I personally couldn’t blame the fans who wanted to catch a glimpse of the Lovely Runner actor. During the show, I saw for myself how charming, gracious (and yes, handsome) he was. When the fan meeting began, the audience was transported to the runways of Paris and Milan for a bit, because the way he walked onstage reminded people that he used to be a fashion model before getting his big break as an actor. A segment titled “Every Moment with Sunjae” saw him reenact scenes from Lovely Runner, with some lucky fans plucked from the audience to play Im Sol, his character Ryu Sunjae’s love interest, played by Korean actress Kim Hye Yoon on the show. The first part of the segment saw Byeon Woo-seok and one lucky fan recreate the infamous photo booth scene from the show, to the delight of the audience. But it was his reenactment of the “cherry blossom” scene with another fan that really brought the house down. In another segment, he sat down with Kring Elenzano-Kim, the host of the fan meeting and a beloved friend of the Pulp Live World family, to play a few games. The most hilarious part of the evening came when he was challenged to ride a minibike. He tried pedaling but struggled because of his towering height. In the end, he passed the challenge with flying colors by using his feet to propel himself and the minibike forward. Later on, he played the “Manila-cation Balance Game,” where he had to choose between two things. He picked visiting tourist spots over a hotel staycation, “no pictures while traveling” over “no music while traveling,” and “staying in a haunted house” over “staying in a cockroach-infested hotel.” Funnily enough, at first, he picked the cockroach-infested hotel, but he later changed his answer to the haunted house. But the fan meeting wasn’t all fun and games. It was also filled with heartfelt moments. When he sat down to watch a VCR with sweet messages from different fans, he was so moved he burst into tears. It started a little funny, though, since there was a short clip of the fans singing and dancing like Im Sol when the latter greeted Kim Tae Sung, her first crush in 2009. But it wasn’t only the fans who surprised Byeon Woo-seok; he also prepared something for the audience. A hush fell over the Filipino TongTongs as a letter he wrote for them flashed onscreen. When the VCR finished playing, he confided to his fans that he felt unwell and was worried about not being able to give his best during the event. “I was worried I wouldn’t be able to fully enjoy this moment with you because of my health,” he began, then explained that the fans’ love and support gave him the strength he needed to carry on. “Your energy helped me enjoy the fan meeting, even though I felt emotional and overwhelmed.” The fan meeting ended with Byeon Woo-seok singing I Think I Did and Sonaki (Sudden Shower), both of which appeared on the soundtrack of Lovely Runner. As he bade farewell to the fans, he said, “I’m very, very happy and this is truly a fan meet that I’ll never forget.” Neither will the Pulp staff. As his car inched slowly down General Roxas Avenue, Byeon Woo-seok rolled down the windows to wave goodbye to those gathered outside the New Frontier Theater. Even as the crowd surged behind me, screaming, waving, and holding up their phones to take photos and videos, I managed to catch a glimpse of the actor as he drove past. In that split-second moment, I saw something in his face that made me a fan. No, it wasn’t his good looks; it was the genuine love and gratitude he felt for the Filipino fans who showed up at his first-ever fan meeting in the country. It’s nice when an artist loves the fans as much as they love him. For an artist like that, I’d gladly form a human barricade anytime. — Julian Mauricio Philstar.com is one of the most vibrant, opinionated, discerning communities of readers on cyberspace. output.description: Byeon Woo-seok is coming back to the Philippines, fresh off the successful run of his latest series "Perfect Crown" opposite IU.
output.text: MANILA, Philippines — Korean actor Byeon Woo-seok is coming back to the Philippines, fresh off the successful run of his latest series "Perfect Crown" opposite IU. Last June 8, Monday, Woo-seok's agency Varo Entertainment, teased on Instagram that the actor has a "new chapter" in development involving a "Secret Library." "Therefore, the Secret Library invites you here to ensure you may take out and read again the time that has been frozen, and record new memories," the agency said. The final image on the agency's carousel was a fan meeting lineup that includes Manila among the Asian cities that the tour will be held. Varo Entertainment then announced that "The Secret Library" was the name of Woo-seok's next fan meeting tour in Asia, and the Philippines is indeed one of the stops. Woo-seok is set to take over the Mall of Asia Arena on October 10 before ending the tour the following month in Indonesia and Hong Kong. A post shared by ??????????????????? (@varoent_official) Show promoter Pulp Live World will likely oversee the production again after commenting on and reposting Varo Entertainment's announcement. "The perfect day to write new stories filled with beautiful and unforgettable memories!" said the promoter, teasing the release of more details in the coming days. The actor was just in the Philippines last year for his "Daydreamin'" fan meet held at the Araneta Coliseum, and the year before that in the New Frontier Theater for his "Summer Letter" Asia Fanmeeting tour. Woo-seok started out as a model before transitioning into acting for cameos in "Dear My Friends," "Moon Lovers: Scarlet Heart Ryeo," and "Weightlifting Fairy Kim Bok-joo." He gained attention for lead roles in "Record of Youth," "Strong Girl Namsoon," "Moonshine," "Soulmate," and his full film debut, "20th Century Girl." Prior to "Perfect Crown" earlier this year, Woo-seok was best known for "Lovely Runner," which was pivotal for him getting cast in the planned live-action adaptation of "Solo Leveling."
